comments.author: @Worker_Table
comments.text: Restaurants in South Korea are generally kept very clean and hygienic. In addition, if a restaurant is caught tampering with food or engaging in unsafe food practices, it will usually face business suspension and strong public criticism. South Korea is also a very safe place to walk around at night, offering visitors the chance to enjoy a wide variety of delicious food and experience a rich and diverse culture.
